title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Oil-led tape, growth lagging. Crude's +1.34% bid carried energy and utilities, while software and comms dragged QQQ to -0.34%. Semis bucked the fade, SOXX +0.91%, but breadth, volume, and elevated September hike odds of 52.1% capped upside.

INDICES — VIX 15.3, below 20-day MA of 17.0. Ranked: SOXX +0.91%, IWM +0.34%, IJH +0.30%, IJR +0.24%, RSP +0.21%, DIA -0.32%, SPY -0.32%, QQQ -0.34%. Small > large by 0.66pp. Oil USO +1.34% standout; gold -0.39%.

VOLUME — SPY at 0.8x avg, QQQ 0.7x — both below average, no accumulation signal. XLRE 1.2x on a -0.72% day is distribution. XLY 0.5x on -0.36% shows sellers absent; low-conviction fade.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy +1.25%, XLU Utilities +1.16%, XLI Industrials +0.60%, XLB Materials +0.11%, XLF Financials -0.02%, XLK Technology -0.12%, XLV Healthcare -0.26%, XLP Staples -0.31%, XLY Discretionary -0.36%, XLC Comms -0.50%, XLRE Real Estate -0.72%. Top: MSOS +5.23%, DRAM +2.60%; bottom: FXI -2.27%, KWEB -3.54%. Money into energy/utilities, out of comms/real estate; oil-driven defensive bid. Broad risk-off.

POSITIONING — QQQ PCR_vol 1.93, heavy protection; SPY 1.05. IV skew positive, fear bid. VIX 15.3 below its 17.0 MA — complacent vs options. MOVE 77.9 above 70.0 MA, bond vol stress.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +1.34% vs gold -0.39% divergence: geopolitics bid crude while safe-haven demand faded. XLE +1.25% against XLC -0.50% shows capital rotating from growth into energy.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 63.6 Greed. Movers: HON -5.27% on Q2 aerospace miss, VRT +4.34%, KLAC +4.01% on dividend news. Worst 20d momentum: XLK +1.35%; best: XLE +6.99%. Watch: SOXX +0.91% on 0.7x volume, diverging from QQQ; XLU +1.16% at 1.0x volume, trend break; KWEB -3.54% — distribution on China exposure.
